name: Dimension Pendulum-Confuse
descriptionTemplate:
{Echo}: At the start of your turn, Draw the 3 Command Cards with the highest Arithmetica from your Draw Pile. The first Command Card played each turn takes effect twice.
{Daze}: After playing a Command Card, discard all other Command Cards with an Arithmetica Cost equal to or higher than it.
